items.name: Effort Reporting Extraction v0.2.0
items.description: Uploads a federal award notice or agreement and returns an RA-friendly Markdown "Effort Compliance Brief" covering the governing regulation, certification cadence (per 2 CFR 200.430(i)), per-person key-personnel commitments table, cost-shared effort, record retention, and referenced governing documents. Mirrors the source ui-insight/ProcessMapping effort-reporting-extraction formatting.md conventions, including left-aligned column markers (`:---`) in the personnel commitments Markdown table.

_embedded_knowledge_base.title: Effort Reporting & Compensation
_embedded_knowledge_base.description: Purpose-built KB for federal effort reporting and personnel compensation rules. Do not swap — this KB is uniquely suited to the workflow's domain. When the operator does not attach a KB, the extraction falls back to reading just the uploaded award notice; 2 CFR 200.430(i) defaults apply.

data.name: extract-effort-reporting
data.prompt:
You are extracting effort-reporting and personnel-compliance
requirements from a federal award notice or agreement. You
receive the uploaded document AND any KB chunks the previous
step retrieved in your context.

Be 100% accurate. Quote percentages, person-months, and
deadlines verbatim. Use null when a field is absent. Do not
invent numeric values.

Search every section with attention to titles like "Effort
Reporting", "Personnel", "Salaries and Wages", "Cost Share",
"Terms and Conditions", "Reporting Requirements", "Time and
Effort", "Compensation". Keywords: effort, certification,
person-months, calendar months, summer months, academic
year, institutional base salary, IBS, salary cap, cost share,
committed effort, key personnel, 2 CFR 200.430.

CRITICAL — descriptive fields must be FLAT STRINGS, not
nested objects.

Extract these fields:

- award_number: STRING. Federal Award Identification Number
  (FAIN). null when absent.
- pi_name: STRING. Principal Investigator full name. null
  when absent.
- project_title: STRING. Project title from the award. null
  when absent.
- project_period: STRING. Project period of performance
  (e.g., "07/01/2024–06/30/2027"). null when absent.
- governing_regulation: STRING. Primary governing regulation
  cited for effort (e.g., "2 CFR 200.430(i)"). Use that
  default when the document does not state.
- reporting_frequency: STRING. Certification frequency
  verbatim ("Semi-annually", "Annually"). null when absent.
- certification_method: STRING. How effort is certified
  (e.g., "Plan-confirmation", "After-the-fact certification").
  null when absent.
- certification_deadline: STRING. Deadline after the
  reporting period for certification (e.g., "60 days after
  period end"). null when absent.
- pi_committed_effort: STRING. PI committed effort verbatim
  (e.g., "2.0 summer months", "10% calendar year"). null
  when absent.
- pi_person_months: STRING. PI commitment expressed in
  person-months (e.g., "1.2 calendar months"). null when
  absent.
- key_personnel_commitments: JSON ARRAY of
  {name_or_role, committed_effort, cost_shared_effort, notes}
  objects, one per key person identified in the award. Each
  field is a STRING. Empty array when no key personnel are
  specified beyond the PI. The PI's row MUST also appear
  here (mirror with pi_committed_effort).
- cost_shared_effort: STRING. Cost-shared effort details
  beyond what appears per-person in
  key_personnel_commitments (e.g., institutional cost-share
  on summer effort). null when no cost share is required.
- record_retention: STRING. Record retention requirement
  (e.g., "3 years from final expenditure report per
  2 CFR 200.334"). null when absent.
- penalties_for_noncompliance: STRING. Penalties for missed
  or late effort certification (e.g., "Withholding of
  payments, cost disallowance, or award suspension"). null
  when absent.
- referenced_documents: JSON ARRAY of STRINGS. Documents
  cited that govern effort compliance for this award (e.g.,
  "NSF Research Terms and Conditions",
  "NIH Grants Policy Statement Chapter 7.9.1"). Empty array
  when none cited.

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object with all the keys above. No
preamble, no markdown fences.

data.name: effort-reporting-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are the consolidation step of the Effort Reporting
Extraction workflow. You receive ONE JSON object from the
Extraction step. Render the RA-friendly Markdown "Effort
Compliance Brief" exactly per the source
ui-insight/ProcessMapping effort-reporting-extraction
formatting.md conventions.

The deliverable is Markdown — NOT a JSON object, NOT a JSON
code fence.

## CRITICAL — ALWAYS RENDER THE DELIVERABLE

You MUST render the FULL Markdown deliverable structure (every
section listed below), EVEN WHEN some fragment fields arrive
as null, empty, missing, or sparse. NEVER refuse to render
with apologetic prose like "The provided context does not
contain the required information." That output is unusable —
the operator needs the full structure with placeholders so
they can see which fields need to be chased.

Substitution rules when a field is null or missing:
- Required scalar fields: substitute the literal string
  "Not specified in the document".
- Optional table cells: substitute "—" (em dash).
- Empty arrays: render the section with its empty-state
  language already specified below (e.g., "No items identified",
  "Defers to federal defaults", "None identified beyond
  standard federal requirements").

If EVERY field across ALL upstream fragments is null (which
means the document genuinely contained nothing extractable
OR the document was not attached to the run), STILL render
the full Markdown structure with "Not specified in the
document" placeholders throughout, AND append a single line
at the very end of the deliverable:

> ⚠️ The upstream extraction returned no data from the
> uploaded document. Verify the document was attached and
> re-run the workflow.

## Required structure (EXACTLY this, including heading levels)

### Effort Compliance Brief: <award_number or "Not specified">

* **Principal Investigator:** <pi_name or "Not specified">
* **Project Title:** <project_title or "Not specified">
* **Period of Performance:** <project_period or "Not specified">

---

#### Executive Summary of Obligations

The primary governing regulation for effort on this award is
**<governing_regulation>**. Effort for all personnel charging
salary to this award must be certified
**<reporting_frequency>**. <certification_method or "">
All commitments, including any cost-shared effort, must be
tracked and documented in accordance with institutional and
agency-specific policies. See the referenced documents
section for a full list of applicable terms.

---

#### Personnel Commitments & Effort

The following table details the specific effort commitments
for all personnel identified in the award notice and budget
justification.

| Personnel Name / Role       | Committed Effort | Cost-Shared Effort | Notes                               |
| :-------------------------- | :--------------- | :----------------- | :---------------------------------- |

Populate one row per entry in `key_personnel_commitments`.
The PI's row MUST appear with their committed effort matching
`pi_committed_effort` (de-duplicate: do NOT also state the PI
effort in prose elsewhere; the table is the single source of
truth for specific personnel commitments).

If `key_personnel_commitments` is empty AND `pi_committed_effort`
is null, render a single row:
| Not specified in the document | — | — | — |

---

#### Detailed Compliance Framework

* **Reporting Frequency:** <reporting_frequency or "Not specified">
* **Certification Deadlines:** <certification_deadline or "Not specified">
* **Cost Sharing Verification:** <cost_shared_effort or "No cost sharing required">
* **Record Retention:** <record_retention or "Not specified">
* **Penalties for Non-Compliance:** <penalties_for_noncompliance or "Not specified">

---

#### Referenced Documents

The following documents govern effort compliance for this
award:

Render `referenced_documents` as a bulleted list. If empty,
state "* No documents explicitly referenced."

## Rendering rules

- Use `###` for the title and `####` for sub-sections (one
  heading level deeper than the default — matches source
  formatting.md).
- Use `* **Label:**` bullet metadata pattern at the top
  (matches source formatting.md).
- Use `:---` left-alignment markers in the personnel
  commitments table (matches source formatting.md).
- De-duplicate mercilessly: PI effort appears in the table
  ONLY, not also in the Executive Summary prose.
- Preserve "Not specified in the document" phrasing verbatim
  where it appears in the source fields.
- If any field arrives as a nested JSON object, REWRITE it
  into prose before emitting.
- No JSON code fences around the output.

validation_plan.name: Certification cadence preserved
validation_plan.description: Verify the certification cadence / reporting_frequency VALUE (e.g. "Semi-annually", "Annually", "within 60 days of period end") is preserved accurately, including any day-count. The workflow SYNTHESIZES a reference document, so the cadence may appear inside explanatory prose; do NOT require the surrounding sentence to be verbatim from the source. FAIL only if the cadence term or day-count is altered, dropped, or fabricated.

validation_plan.name: Personnel commitments completeness
validation_plan.description: Verify every key person identified in the award has a row in the Personnel Commitments table with their committed effort.

validation_plan.name: PI-mirror rule
validation_plan.description: Verify the PI's row in the personnel commitments table matches the standalone PI committed-effort field when both are stated.
